events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A six-day café-inspired fragrance experience celebrating COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery, CHANEL makeup and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance-discovery experience are free. Purchases are optional; no guaranteed giveaway is stated by CHANEL.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore optional rather than required or approval-based; walk-in access can still depend on capacity.
events.practical_notes: September 11 noon–7 PM; September 12–13 and 19–20 10 AM–7 PM; September 18 noon–7 PM at 873 Washington Street.

events.event_name: The Ethereal Fashion Gallery at Tesla Manhattan
events.address: Tesla Manhattan, 860 Washington St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: An NYFW opening-night fashion gallery inside Tesla Manhattan with designer installations, live music, test drives, content moments and networking.
events.what_is_free: The listing advertises complimentary drinks and access to the gallery experience after approval; no paid ticket is displayed on the registration page.
events.caveats: Luma explicitly says Approval Required, registration is subject to host approval, and attendance is invite-and-approval only. Requesting access does not mean you are admitted.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 6–9 PM at Tesla Manhattan, 860 Washington Street.

events.address: Magic Hour Rooftop Bar & Lounge, 485 7th Ave, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A late-night NYFW gathering celebrating Indigenous creatives, designers and models at Magic Hour Rooftop.
events.what_is_free: The public Partiful page offers a guest-list RSVP with no ticket price shown.
events.caveats: The event is open to everyone but the guest list is capped at 200. The host states entry after midnight is limited at the venue's discretion, so being on the list is not equivalent to guaranteed late-night entry.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 at 11 PM. RSVP through Partiful before the listed cutoff and arrive before midnight for the clearest access path.

events.event_name: The Greenhouse & Onata Haus × TILA Trunkshow
events.address: This is Latin America, 234 Grand St, Brooklyn, NY 11211
events.what_it_is: A multi-day trunk show featuring emerging-market fashion brands and a curated Onata Haus assortment, with public shopping hours and a Saturday charm-bar program.
events.what_is_free: Public entry to browse the trunk show is free. Merchandise purchases are optional; the listing does not promise a free item to every visitor.
events.caveats: Luma says the trunk show is open to the public Friday 11 AM–5 PM, Saturday 11 AM–7 PM and Sunday 11 AM–2 PM. Friday also mentions private styling by appointment, which is a separate service rather than a restriction on general public browsing.
events.practical_notes: September 11 11 AM–5 PM; September 12 11 AM–7 PM; September 13 11 AM–2 PM at 234 Grand Street, Brooklyn.

events.event_name: Guest House: Welcome Home at The Wang Contemporary
events.address: The Wang Contemporary, 58 Bowery, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A free exhibition of life-size wax sculptures by Zhou Xuerong that places familiar American pop-culture figures in distinctly Chinese settings.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the exhibition is free. Current listings promote a free reservation, but do not establish organizer approval or a paid ticket requirement.
events.caveats: Sources describe the exhibition as free and open to the public every Friday through Sunday through September 27. A free reservation is promoted, but the available source text does not say walk-ins are barred or that reservations require approval.
events.practical_notes: September 11–27, Fridays through Sundays, 11 AM–6 PM at 58 Bowery.
